text_blocks.snippet: Merck's COVID-19 drug is molnupiravir, marketed under the brand name LAGEVRIO. It's an oral antiviral pill designed to reduce the risk of hospitalization and death in adults with mild to moderate COVID-19 who are at high risk for severe illness, according to Merck.com. The drug works by inhibiting the replication of the SARS-CoV-2 virus, according to Merck.com. In clinical trials, molnupiravir has shown a reduction in the risk of hospitalization or death by approximately 50%.
